visualCharacteristics.purpose: Product intro text beside a main image + thumbnail gallery
visualCharacteristics.description: Product spotlight intro: text/spec column (title, subheading, intro, bullet list, application note links, CTAs, resources links) beside an image gallery made of a main image and a strip of thumbnails.

contentPattern.structure: Row 0 (block field): richtext text column. Rows 1..N: one Product Image item each (image + imageAlt); the first image is the main image, the rest are thumbnails

reuseGuidance: Use at the top of product detail pages for the intro text next to a product image gallery.
